legend: The Wampus Cat (Appalachian Mountains, USA, Cherokee-linked folklore)
lines: In the Appalachian mountains, people tell of a cat that walks like a woman.
They call her the Wampus Cat.
Some say it began with a woman who spied on the hunters' sacred ritual.
Legend says she hid inside a cougar skin, but was caught.
As her punishment, the skin could never come off.
Now she prowls the forests at night, half woman, half cat, with glowing yellow eyes.
Hunters hear a scream unlike any animal they know.
Their dogs fall silent, and the woods go still.
Would you walk that trail after dark?
title: The Cat That Walks Like a Woman in the Appalachians #shorts
description:
Appalachian folklore tells of the Wampus Cat, half woman and half cougar, with glowing yellow eyes and a scream hunters never forget. Real legend or just a story by the fire?
